stories.headline: King Harald V of Norway dies at 89 as son Haakon VIII ascends throne
stories.body: King Harald V of Norway died on August 28 at the age of 89 [c1]. He ruled Norway for 35 years [c1]. His 53-year-old son immediately became the new monarch as King Haakon VIII [c2]. Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store said that an era has ended and a new one begins [c3]. Store added that the king is dead and long live the king [c3]. King Harald V stayed in an Oslo hospital from August 17 [c4]. He suffered from haemolytic anaemia [c4]. The Norwegian Armed Forces honoured the late king with a 21-shot funeral salute [c5]. They fired the salute from Akershus Fortress in central Oslo [c5]. King Haakon VIII's 22-year-old daughter Ingrid Alexandra became the new crown princess and next in line to the throne [c6]. Britain's King Charles III paid tribute to King Harald V [c7]. King Charles III called him a towering figure who guided Norway with warmth and humility [c7]. Public support for the monarchy in Norway dropped to 54% in February from 72% in 2024 [c8]. In June, Crown Princess Mette-Marit's son, Marius Borg Hoiby, received a four-year prison sentence after a rape conviction [c9].

vocab.meaning: related to the breakdown of red blood cells
a system of government led by a king or queen

stories.headline: US announces deal with Venezuela securing majority control of oil reserves
stories.body: US President Donald Trump announced an agreement with Venezuela to secure American control over massive oil reserves [c10]. The deal covers more than 65 billion barrels of proven oil reserves in Venezuela [c10]. A US official said that the US government will retain 55% effective control of a joint venture under the deal [c12]. That joint venture includes a private operator [c12]. The private operator was granted a 100-year concession in Venezuela [c12]. Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez said the agreement involves developing 17 strategic oil fields [c11]. Rodriguez said the project will draw over $100 billion in investment [c11]. She added that the operation will generate over $209 billion in state taxes [c11]. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the Venezuela oil deal will bring nearly $100 billion in private investment [c14]. Rubio said the project will support thousands of high-paying jobs [c14]. The agreement comes after political changes in South America. On January 3, US special forces captured former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro [c13]. US special forces also captured his wife, Cilia Flores, on that day [c13]. In early August, the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve dropped below 300 million barrels [c15]. The reserve has decreased by over 100 million barrels since early 2026 [c15]. On August 28, the average price of petrol in the United States reached $4.09 a gallon [c16]. That price compares to $3.21 a gallon recorded one year earlier [c16].

vocab.meaning: a right granted by a government to use land or property for a business purpose
important for reaching a long-term goal or plan

stories.headline: Israel kills three Palestinian fighters in West Bank drone strike
stories.body: Israel killed three Palestinians in a drone strike in the West Bank town of Jenin [c17]. The attack was the first Israeli military air strike in the West Bank since February 2025 [c17]. The Israeli military said it eliminated three militants during the strike [c18]. Military officials identified one of the dead men as Hamas operative Qais Bitawi [c18]. Palestinian Islamic Jihad said that Qais Bitawi and two other men killed in Jenin were its fighters [c19]. Palestinian Islamic Jihad identified Bitawi as a leader in the Al-Quds Brigades [c19]. The Palestinian Red Crescent said Israeli forces briefly detained its medical crews at the strike site [c20]. The organization said Israeli forces confiscated its equipment [c20]. Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz posted on social media about the operation [c21]. Katz posted on X that the strike shows the fruits of an aggressive policy in the West Bank [c21]. Katz wrote that Israel does not wait for terror, but pursues it, conquers its strongholds, and thwarts its people [c21].

vocab.meaning: people who use violent methods to support a political cause
took something away with official authority

stories.headline: Meta agrees to $18 billion settlement and new youth safety rules
stories.body: Meta agreed to an $18 billion settlement with US states and territories [c22]. The agreement ends a federal lawsuit alleging that Meta's social media platforms harmed children's mental health [c22]. Meta agreed to implement a combined default daily screen-time limit of two hours across Facebook and Instagram for minor accounts [c23]. Meta will introduce an automatic night mode blocking minor profiles from Feeds, Stories, Reels, and Explore pages between midnight and 6:00 am [c24]. Meta's new School Mode will default to muting standard push notifications for teenage users between 8:00 am and 3:00 pm [c25]. Meta announced it will withhold $5 billion of its $18 billion settlement [c26]. Meta will withhold the funds until rival platforms like TikTok and YouTube enter into similar youth protection agreements [c26].

vocab.meaning: an official agreement that resolves a legal dispute
claiming that someone did something illegal without proof yet

stories.headline: Greenland creates truth commission to examine historic forced contraception campaign
stories.body: Greenland announced the creation of a Truth and Reconciliation Commission to examine a historical forced contraception campaign [c27]. The commission will examine actions taken against Indigenous Inuit women and girls [c27]. A joint inquiry revealed that between the 1960s and 1990s, at least 4,000 Greenlandic Inuits were fitted with IUDs or received contraceptive injections without informed consent [c28]. By the late 1970s, at least 4,070 women had been fitted with an IUD [c32]. That figure represented one out of every two Greenlandic women of childbearing age [c32]. The Danish parliament approved compensation payments of up to 300,000 Danish crowns, or $46,758, for each affected woman [c29]. A four-member expert panel appointed to investigate the campaign split and submitted two conflicting reports on whether the actions constituted genocide [c30]. Panel experts Dalee Sambo Dorough and Miriam Cullen determined that Inuit women's rights were violated [c31]. However, they said they could not conclude genocide occurred based on contraceptive practices alone [c31].

vocab.meaning: the process of restoring friendly relations after a dispute

stories.headline: Nepal and China report nearly 600 deaths after flash floods hit region
stories.body: Nepal and Chinese authorities reported nearly 600 flood deaths after a glacier collapsed on Wednesday [c34], [c35]. The glacier collapse triggered flash floods across Nepal and Tibet, leaving over 2,400 people missing [c34]. Nepal's official death toll reached 579, while Chinese state media reported seven deaths in Tibet [c35]. Authorities reported at least 2,478 people missing after the flood [c37]. That total included 1,924 missing in Nepal and 554 missing in Tibet [c37]. More than 3,700 people have been rescued in Nepal [c38]. The Red Cross said at least 93,000 people were affected by the disaster [c38]. Chinese authorities evacuated 555 stranded tourists and 499 Chinese residents from Tibet [c36]. Nepal Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said Nepal needs foreign technical assistance for specialized tasks [c33]. Khanal mentioned tunnel rescue, body identification, DNA testing, and body storage [c33]. Nepal Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle said Nepal will require at least a few billion dollars to recover from the flood destruction [c42]. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah shortly after the disaster to offer humanitarian assistance [c40]. India sent 62 tonnes of emergency relief assistance to Nepal across three airlifts [c39]. The United Arab Emirates allocated $10 million in humanitarian aid to Nepal through the UAE Aid Agency [c41]. Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar received 21 pilgrims from Tamil Nadu who were rescued from flood areas in Nepal [c43]. At least 320 Indian nationals remained uncontactable in Nepal [c44]. Official sources said 149 Indian nationals crossed over from China into Nepal on August 28, 2026 [c45].

vocab.meaning: concerned with helping people and reducing suffering
unable to be reached or communicated with

stories.headline: Karnataka Minister B. Nagendra resigns following financial irregularity allegations
stories.body: Karnataka Minister B. Nagendra submitted his resignation on Friday [c46]. His resignation came 25 days after he was re-inducted into the state cabinet [c46]. Nagendra faces opposition allegations regarding the alleged misappropriation of ₹89 crore from the Karnataka Maharshi Valmiki Scheduled Tribes Development Corporation [c47]. Nagendra requested permission from Congress leadership to resign as a member of the legislative assembly in addition to stepping down from his cabinet position [c48]. Announcing his decision, Nagendra said that he was voluntarily tendering his resignation as minister [c51]. Financial irregularities in the corporation surfaced in May 2024 after an accounts superintendent died by suicide and left a note alleging unauthorized fund transfers [c49]. Nagendra had previously resigned as tribal welfare minister in June 2024 [c50]. He was re-inducted into the cabinet on August 3 after D.K. Shivakumar became Chief Minister [c50]. Protests by opposition parties over Nagendra's return led to the Karnataka Legislature's monsoon session being adjourned on August 24 [c52]. Police took BJP leaders B.Y. Vijayendra and R. Ashoka into preventive custody during a protest march toward the Vidhana Soudha in Bengaluru [c53].

vocab.meaning: the dishonest or illegal taking of money for wrong use
intended to stop something from happening before it occurs

stories.headline: Indian food authority proposes red warning labels on packaged food high in fat and sugar
stories.body: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India proposed red hexagonal warning labels on packaged foods [c54]. The agency filed a compliance affidavit with the Supreme Court detailing the proposal [c54]. The case stems from a public interest lawsuit filed by the NGO 3S and Our Health Society [c55]. On August 13, a Supreme Court bench led by Justice J.B. Pardiwala issued an order giving the government two weeks to submit its final decision [c58]. Proposed warning labels will display terms like High Fat, High Sugar, High Salt, or Highly Sweetened Beverage [c57]. The label text will use a font size one point larger than the nutrition table on the back [c57]. Single-ingredient foods such as ghee, edible oil, salt, sugar, jaggery, and honey are proposed to be exempted [c56]. Proposed thresholds are based on the Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2024 [c61]. The agency proposed implementing warning labels in two phases [c60]. The first phase will start with foods high in two or more specified nutrients before extending to single nutrients [c60]. A study in The Lancet estimated that roughly 450 million people in India could be overweight or obese by 2050 [c59]. Senior Coca-Cola India executive Mili Bhattacharya said during a March 19 meeting that believing a symbol on a label will improve a diet is very simplistic [c62].

vocab.meaning: a written statement confirmed by oath for use as evidence in court
freed from an obligation or requirement that applies to others

stories.headline: India signs agreement to buy Javelin anti-tank missiles from United States
stories.body: India plans to purchase the Javelin anti-tank guided missile system from the United States [c63]. US Ambassador to India Sergio Gor announced the purchasing plan [c63]. India signed a Letter of Offer and Acceptance with the United States to buy the system through Foreign Military Sales [c69]. The proposed sale is valued at $45.7 million [c65]. The Javelin is a man-portable missile that uses fire-and-forget technology to track and hit targets automatically after launch [c64]. The system has been in full-rate production since 1994 and reached its 50,000th delivery in 2021 [c70]. India requested to buy 100 FGM-148 Javelin rounds, one fly-to-buy missile, and 25 Javelin Command Launch Units [c68]. In November 2025, the US State Department approved a potential $93 million sale involving up to 100 Javelin systems and 216 Excalibur artillery projectiles [c67]. Ambassador Gor said that US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth raised the possibility of joint co-production at the May 2026 Shangri-La Dialogue [c66].

vocab.meaning: easy to carry or move by hand
objects designed to be shot or thrown forward through the air
